nodes.title: Operating system
nodes.assumption: Windows 10/11, macOS or Linux on x64 or arm64
nodes.manualFix: Beethoven supports Windows, macOS and Linux laptops
nodes.futureRisk: a new OS release changing OpenSSH or the keychain

nodes.title: OpenSSH client
nodes.assumption: ssh 7.3+ on PATH (ProxyJump); on Windows the built-in OpenSSH client
nodes.manualFix: Windows: Settings > System > Optional features > OpenSSH Client; macOS/Linux: install openssh-client
nodes.futureRisk: an OpenSSH release dropping hmac-sha1, which the grid still needs

nodes.title: ssh-keygen
nodes.assumption: ssh-keygen can make ed25519 keys
nodes.manualFix: install the OpenSSH client (it includes ssh-keygen)

nodes.title: VS Code version
nodes.assumption: VS Code 1.100 or newer
nodes.manualFix: Help > Check for Updates
nodes.futureRisk: API removals in a future VS Code

nodes.title: Remote-SSH extension
nodes.assumption: ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh installed (opening grid files and images)
nodes.manualFix: install ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh from the Extensions view
nodes.futureRisk: the extension renamed or its commands changed

nodes.title: Claude Code extension
nodes.assumption: anthropic.claude-code installed (the local Claude, its own sign-in, the bridge)
nodes.manualFix: install anthropic.claude-code from the Extensions view
nodes.futureRisk: the extension renamed or its commands changed

nodes.title: Claude Code program
nodes.assumption: the claude executable bundled with the Claude Code extension runs
nodes.manualFix: reinstall the Claude Code extension
nodes.futureRisk: the extension moving its bundled binary

nodes.title: Terminal shell integration
nodes.assumption: terminal.integrated.shellIntegration.enabled is on (Beethoven reads the Claude token from the terminal)
nodes.manualFix: Settings: Terminal > Integrated > Shell Integration: Enabled

nodes.title: Keychain (VS Code secret storage)
nodes.assumption: tokens can be stored and read back from the OS keychain
nodes.manualFix: Linux: install a keyring (gnome-keyring or kwallet); restart VS Code
nodes.futureRisk: a keychain backend change

nodes.title: Remote-SSH settings for the grid
nodes.assumption: remote.SSH.connectTimeout >= 300 (compute nodes take ~25 s per session; the first connection downloads the server)
nodes.manualFix: Settings: remote.SSH.connectTimeout = 300
nodes.futureRisk: Remote-SSH changing its timeout semantics

nodes.title: Internet from this laptop
nodes.assumption: HTTPS to github.com, huggingface.co and anthropic.com
nodes.manualFix: check the Wi-Fi; some campus networks block token checks (the grid checks them instead)

nodes.title: License terms accepted
nodes.assumption: the current version of the agreement and privacy statement was accepted in the signing dialog, and the record with the texts is on this laptop
nodes.manualFix: run any Beethoven command: the signing dialog appears; Beethoven: Read the license terms shows the text
nodes.futureRisk: a new terms version (every installation is asked again); the record folder deleted by hand

nodes.title: Beethoven license
nodes.assumption: a license key signed by a key this release trusts, in date (or in its grace period), not withdrawn
nodes.manualFix: Beethoven: License, then paste the key your lead sent; a new key if it ended or was withdrawn
nodes.futureRisk: the signing key rotating (a new release trusts the new key); the revocation list address moving

nodes.title: License names the signed-in person
nodes.assumption: the AccessID (or e-mail) in the license matches the Wayne State sign-in Beethoven recorded
nodes.manualFix: sign in with the account the license names (setup step "Sign in with Wayne State"), or ask your lead for a license in your name
nodes.futureRisk: Wayne State changing the sign-in e-mail format (AccessID@wayne.edu)

nodes.title: Wayne State sign-in and the lab list
nodes.assumption: signed in with AccessID@wayne.edu; AccessID on the pre-approved list
nodes.manualFix: run the wizard step "Sign in with Wayne State"; if not on the list, ask your lead
nodes.futureRisk: the WSU tenant blocking VS Code sign-in

nodes.title: GitHub token
nodes.assumption: GitHub token stored in the keychain and accepted by the service
nodes.manualFix: press Renew next to "GitHub personal access token" in the setup panel, or click its row in the Beethoven view
nodes.futureRisk: token formats or scopes changing

nodes.title: Hugging Face token
nodes.assumption: Hugging Face token stored in the keychain and accepted by the service
nodes.manualFix: press Renew next to "Hugging Face access token" in the setup panel, or click its row in the Beethoven view
nodes.futureRisk: token formats or scopes changing

nodes.title: Claude on this laptop
nodes.assumption: Claude Code on this laptop is signed in with the student's own Claude Pro or Max subscription (Beethoven reads status only)
nodes.manualFix: sign in to Claude Code on this laptop (setup step "Claude on this laptop")
nodes.futureRisk: claude auth status changing its output; plan names changing

nodes.title: SSH key for the grid
nodes.assumption: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_wsu and .pub exist
nodes.manualFix: run the wizard steps "SSH key" and "Log in to the grid once"

nodes.title: SSH configuration block
nodes.assumption: the Beethoven block in ~/.ssh/config is current (jump host, MACs +hmac-sha1, AddressFamily inet, *.nas.grid.wayne.edu)
nodes.manualFix: run the wizard step "SSH configuration"
nodes.futureRisk: the grid dropping hmac-sha1 or renaming nodes

nodes.title: Login node without a prompt
nodes.assumption: ssh -o BatchMode=yes wsu-grid answers (key installed, no password or code)
nodes.manualFix: Permission denied: run "Log in to the grid once" again; timed out: check the network (the grid accepts SSH from anywhere)
nodes.futureRisk: the login host renamed, 2FA enforced for keys

nodes.title: Prompt relay (open session)
nodes.assumption: one persistent ssh session carries prompts in tens of milliseconds
nodes.manualFix: Beethoven falls back to one ssh per prompt; check the grid relay node

nodes.title: Beethoven scripts on the grid
nodes.assumption: the grid has this extension's scripts (same version, LF line endings)
nodes.manualFix: run the wizard step "Install on the grid"
nodes.futureRisk: a home directory restore or clean-up removing ~/.beethoven

nodes.title: Beethoven block in ~/.bashrc
nodes.assumption: the block exporting the VS Code sysroot variables and PATH
nodes.manualFix: ssh wsu-grid "~/.beethoven/bin/beethoven install"
nodes.futureRisk: a new default .bashrc from C&IT

nodes.title: VS Code compatibility libraries (C&IT sysroot)
nodes.assumption: /wsu/apps/vscode sysroot and patchelf exist at the paths in the block
nodes.manualFix: ask hpc@wayne.edu where the VS Code sysroot moved
nodes.futureRisk: Wayne State moving or upgrading the sysroot (repair rediscovers it)

nodes.title: Nothing of yours left under /tmp on the login node
nodes.assumption: no container build leftovers (rootfs-*, build-temp-*, apptainer*) or files over 50 MB of yours under /tmp on the login node, which C&IT keeps free of user files; Beethoven builds containers only inside Slurm jobs with node-local temp and cache
nodes.manualFix: ssh wsu-grid and remove your files under /tmp (repair removes the recognisable leftovers)
nodes.futureRisk: a container command run by hand on the login node; a build job killed before its cleanup trap

nodes.title: Slurm commands
nodes.assumption: sbatch, squeue, sacct, scancel work on the login node
nodes.manualFix: contact hpc@wayne.edu
nodes.futureRisk: a Slurm upgrade changing output formats

nodes.title: Access requests visible to the admin
nodes.assumption: Slurm PrivateData=none (the admin sees the held access-request jobs)
nodes.manualFix: the admin can grant directly without a request
nodes.futureRisk: C&IT enabling PrivateData=jobs

nodes.title: Slurm partitions and QoS
nodes.assumption: the account has the requeue or secondary QoS
nodes.manualFix: ask your lead / hpc@wayne.edu for the QoS
nodes.futureRisk: QoS renamed by C&IT

nodes.title: Internet from the grid
nodes.assumption: HTTPS from the login node; curl reads secrets from stdin (-K -)
nodes.manualFix: contact hpc@wayne.edu
nodes.futureRisk: a proxy introduced on the grid

nodes.title: ACL tools (setfacl/getfacl)
nodes.assumption: POSIX ACL tools present (lab access)
nodes.manualFix: contact hpc@wayne.edu
nodes.futureRisk: the lab volume moved to a filesystem without ACLs

nodes.title: Home directory quota
nodes.assumption: home below 98 % of its soft quota
nodes.manualFix: delete or move large files; ask your lead for lab storage
nodes.futureRisk: quota policy changes

nodes.title: GitHub token on the grid
nodes.assumption: the grid copy of the GitHub token verifies
nodes.manualFix: press Renew next to GitHub
nodes.futureRisk: GitHub token expiry policies

nodes.title: Hugging Face token on the grid
nodes.assumption: the grid copy of the Hugging Face token verifies
nodes.manualFix: press Renew next to Hugging Face
nodes.futureRisk: Hugging Face token changes

nodes.title: Claude signed in on the grid
nodes.assumption: Claude Code on the grid reports its own sign-in (made by the student with beethoven claude login; Beethoven never touches the credential)
nodes.manualFix: run Beethoven: Sign in to Claude on the grid (the sign-in lasts about a month)
nodes.futureRisk: Anthropic changing the login flow or its lifetime

nodes.title: Beethoven license on the grid
nodes.assumption: the grid has the same license key as this laptop, and every running worker accepts it for this grid account
nodes.manualFix: Troubleshoot and repair copies it; a worker started before licensing needs a restart (Beethoven: Stop a worker, then Start)
nodes.futureRisk: a worker template older than the license check

nodes.title: Claude accounts on the grid
nodes.assumption: one subscription token per person, no copied logins, and every account shares one session history (so a conversation survives a move to your API key)
nodes.manualFix: Troubleshoot and repair links the history; remove extra accounts with: ssh wsu-grid "beethoven accounts remove NAME"
nodes.futureRisk: Claude Code moving where --resume looks for transcripts

nodes.title: Lab access
nodes.assumption: the lab folder is readable (approved), or a request is pending
nodes.manualFix: the last wizard step: Join the lab
nodes.futureRisk: the lab folder moving

nodes.title: Container runtime (Apptainer)
nodes.assumption: the configured apptainer executable exists (repair switches to the current module)
nodes.manualFix: ask your lead to republish the container
nodes.futureRisk: Wayne State upgrading or removing the apptainer module

nodes.title: Lab Claude container
nodes.assumption: the lab container is adopted (repair runs beethoven adopt)
nodes.manualFix: wait for lab access
nodes.futureRisk: a republished container at a new path

nodes.title: Prompt relay on the login node
nodes.assumption: beethoven relay answers PING
nodes.manualFix: reinstall Beethoven on the grid
nodes.futureRisk: bash changes on the login node

nodes.title: Lab folder layout (admin)
nodes.assumption: the lab folder is closed to other users and requests go through Slurm
nodes.manualFix: ssh wsu-grid "beethoven access init"
nodes.futureRisk: someone widening permissions by hand

nodes.title: Claude workers
nodes.assumption: every running worker job has a daemon that answers (heartbeat under 90 s)
nodes.manualFix: Beethoven: Stop a worker, then Start a worker
nodes.futureRisk: node images changing under the container

nodes.title: Slurm inside the workers
nodes.assumption: the worker's Claude can submit and watch Slurm jobs from inside its container (the host client, its library, munge and the config are bound in)
nodes.manualFix: Troubleshoot and repair restarts a worker started before version 3; if it still fails, tell your lead (the detail names the missing piece)
nodes.futureRisk: Wayne State moving the Slurm client, its library, munge or slurm.conf; a Slurm upgrade that needs more host libraries

nodes.title: Compute node and container
nodes.assumption: inside a worker: the container runs node and Claude Code, has a pseudo-terminal and HTTPS
nodes.manualFix: restart the worker; if it persists tell your lead
nodes.futureRisk: a node OS or kernel update breaking the container

nodes.title: Phone access
nodes.assumption: when turned on, the worker's Remote Control session runs
nodes.manualFix: Beethoven: Phone access (sign in again if asked)
nodes.futureRisk: Remote Control flags or login flow changing

nodes.title: Claude Code bridge to the grid (MCP)
nodes.assumption: the beethoven MCP server is registered with Claude Code and connects
nodes.manualFix: Beethoven: Connect the Claude Code extension to the grid
nodes.futureRisk: claude mcp CLI changes; Electron-as-node removed from VS Code
